name: Kievan Rus'
summary: A medieval East Slavic state ruled from Kiev by the Rurik dynasty. It adopted Orthodox Christianity around 988 and is a shared ancestor of Ukraine, Belarus and Russia.

knownFor.label: Russkaya Pravda
knownFor.note: The first written law code of Rus’.

knownFor.label: St Sophia’s Cathedral
knownFor.note: A cathedral in Kiev with Byzantine-style mosaics.

knownFor.label: Route from the Varangians to the Greeks
knownFor.note: A river trade route linking the Baltic and Constantinople.

location.value: Eastern Europe, from the Baltic to the Black Sea steppe, ruled from Kiev.

terrain.value: Forests and steppe, linked by rivers (Dnieper, Volkhov, Volga).
terrain.source: Franklin & Shepard, The Emergence of Rus 750–1200 (1996)
